what: The cold/warm pair of ONE tree, same content, same instrumentation. Both runs held the gate-lane slot (so the gate's own nested fixtures inherited admission through GATE_LANE_HELD) and both gated the persistent tree this branch's merge-lane created.
tree: C:/Users/Victor/.wasm-agent/merge-lane-tree-measure (created on the first attempt, reused by both runs: clone.reused = true)
method: WA_MERGE_LANE_TREE naming the persistent tree; node scripts/merge-lane.mjs --repo <clone of this branch> --base ab827c8 bfbcd5e; the gate ran bash scripts/test.sh inside that tree; phases read back by the lane from the gate's own GATE_PHASES_JSON.
same_stopping_point: Both runs END inside the self-update phase, in the wrapper defect of docs/MERGE-SPEED.md section 3b (scripts/test-deploy-service-target.sh fails 6 of 34 THROUGH the shims, exit 0 without them), so neither has a verdict line and both tables stop at the same phase. That is what makes the pair comparable phase-for-phase on one tree, and it is why the wrapper must not land as it stands.
